note: Board and go (brief 018 §5), the twin of route-g: the same route to the ambush; then the Enforcer walks Vale to the car as it springs, the three fire until the blocker is down, then board, and the car leaves with the whole cell. Route G, knockout (brief 013 D; Motive 013 §6.1 G-KO): the Scout watches the guard (his sight and check-in marks), the Tech loops the entrance camera and reroutes the patrol, the Enforcer knocks the guard out from beside just after his 2:30 mark and leaves him where he fell, enters at once and takes Vale out by the service lane; the cell fights the rivals' ambush at the getaway car. No contact, $0. A knockout found is an inquiry (Alert 1 at most): the camera reads him once the loop goes, his 4:00 mark is missed, guard 74 finds him; he gives a statement (+4 T).
